reason: At base, REGEX_FORMAT matches Y{1,4} but format() only implements YY/YYYY, so lone Y and YYY fall through to the timezone-offset fallback and return something like +0000 rather than literal Y / 24Y.
After the change REGEX_FORMAT only matches YYYY|YY, so a lone Y is left untouched and YYY is consumed as YY plus a leftover literal Y, matching the expected 24Y-style output.
At base, #getDecodedParam already decodes any path param containing % via tryDecodeURIComponent, so %20 is returned as a space.
The refactor only moves the same percent-decode-if-needed check into a shared helper; a %20 path param is still decoded to a space.
reschedule writes the new score to Redis via zincrby but does not update @score, so the same in-memory entry still reports the old time.
The head revision sets @score = at.to_f after zincrby, so entry.score and entry.at immediately reflect the new reschedule time.
The PR only trims Range-header list elements; Content-Type parsing is untouched and already understands text/plain; charset=UTF-8.
Same unrelated Range-header change; charset Content-Type parsing is unchanged and still reports text/plain with charset UTF-8.
The PR only sanitizes download-failure log messages and does not touch zip archiving; Composer archive from on-disk sources already records each file's mtime rather than the zip 1980 default.
Logging-only change; re-archiving still copies source mtimes into the zip, so both extractions match the original timestamps.
CredentialCache path matching is unrelated to JsonSerializer; DeserializeAsync of a list with a nullable parent property is supported core behavior and should complete without JsonException.
The CredentialCache change does not affect System.Text.Json; sync and async Deserialize of the same payload remain equivalent.
The PR only fixes FETCH FIRST on an empty WITH HOLD cursor; INET <<= ANY is existing PG-compatible SQL and should return true for an address inside the subnet.
Cursor FETCH FIRST is unrelated to INET operators; >>= ANY over an inet array should parse and return true because 10.0.0.0/8 contains 10.1.2.3.
At base every NO_PROXY entry is turned into all://*<host>, so ::1 becomes all://*::1, which later URL parsing cannot interpret and client construction errors.
Head treats IPv6 NO_PROXY entries as all://[::1], so client construction succeeds and ::1 is a bypass host rather than a broken pattern.
The prior flags validation compiles the pattern then compares a reconstructed flag set that only keeps IGNORECASE, so re.DOTALL (flags= or compiled) raises instead of matching a\nc.
The fix stops rejecting non-IGNORECASE flags and honors DOTALL on both a flags= call and a compiled pattern, so a\nc matches a.c and ac does not.

prepare_steps does not refresh prev_task/prev_res after a mid-chain group, so parent links on a task-group-group-task canvas are wrong and the serialized result tree drops children from the later group.
Head updates prev_task and prev_res after each group so subsequent groups keep distinct child results; reconstructing the serialized tree still has four children across the two groups.
The bug is only when -- is the first token; with value1 value2 already consumed, -- already acts as value_terminator and --check is collected by the next positional.
The new terminator-precedence branch still lets positional parsing consume a mid-stream --, so value1/value2 stay in the first arg and --check goes to the second.
After startup, nvim_set_option_value('background') on a late OSC 11 response fires OptionSet, and changing background reloads the colorscheme so ColorScheme fires too.
Head sets background with :noautocmd specifically to suppress OptionSet (and other autocommands) on OSC 11, so the registered OptionSet and ColorScheme handlers do not run.
The PR only reorders a @derive read for Inspect; validate_required on a missing text field still marks the changeset invalid with can't be blank.
Same compile-time derive-only change; cast plus validate_required still reports the omitted required field as can't be blank.
